scope: Real server screenshots only; rounded values, not full server result files
precision: Terminal .4g for numeric estimates/q; exact displayed integer people counts; display strings preserved
notes: +E and +C are parallel additions to BG; +C does not include E
C2 is mean of meal carbohydrate squared, not squared person mean carbohydrate
q_full applies only to meal_adjusted; other q values and all confidence intervals absent from pages 2/3
Same members and meals across five steps within each setting/diet, not common membership across diets
28 endpoint estimates and people counts match archived old results at current display precision; old q14 not copied
Models shown are 70 unique specifications: 42 intermediate specifications newly displayed relative to prior quality results plus 28 repeated endpoints
Original and joint overlap; coefficient shifts are descriptive and do not establish causal mechanisms
